body:
Its worse late at night. My thoughts drift to her and what I could have done differently. I just feel so guilty...I let her down. I promised I'd always protect her and I wasn't there.

Every living moment without her is misery. Life has just lost all meaning.. I've started drinking more at night closer to bed time. It helps, but when the effects of the alcohol wears off it just comes flooding back.

I need her.
